summary: Milestone-1 catalogue journey tested end-to-end on the mock data source at mobile viewport (390x844). Splash renders the APEPS wordmark + spinner and hands off to Home. Home shows hero banner, category rail, Featured/New/Best product rails and support card. Bottom tabs (Home/Shop/Search/Orders/Account) all switch screens; top-bar basket button navigates to Basket and the basket-badge count updates live. Shop screen renders result count, sort sheet (sort-option-*), view-toggle (grid/list) and filter chips (sale/instock/all/cat-*). Product detail works for BOTH simple and variable products: for the variable product (id 104 Protein Powder) add-to-basket-button is correctly disabled and reads 'Select options' until both Flavour + Size are chosen, then it becomes enabled and adds the matched variation. Simple product adds show added-toast and increment basket-badge. Favourite heart toggles from the product page and the /favourites screen lists, removes and re-adds items. Basket supports qty steppers, coupon APEPS10 (coupon-applied appears), a subtotal estimate and an honest 'calculated at checkout' block; tapping proceed-checkout-button surfaces checkout-note. Persistence verified: basket + favourites survive full page reload. Orders and Account tabs render the honest Phase-2 sign-in state; Account shows a MOCK DATA badge and account-favourites/account-basket rows navigate correctly. Category screen loads via /category/[id]. Search screen debounces (>=2 chars), returns results, saves recent searches (with clear-recent-searches), shows category suggestions and a search-empty state. No red-screen errors, no broken tappables, no navigation gaps. Only non-blocking warnings observed on the web preview.

issues: React-Native-Web hydration warning: '<button> cannot be a descendant of <button>' logged on the Shop listing. Cosmetic on web only (native unaffected); likely caused by a Pressable nested inside another Pressable in the product card (e.g., favourite heart inside the card Pressable). Consider using a View + onStartShouldSetResponder or splitting the touch targets so the heart is a sibling, not a child, of the card Pressable. Reference: src/components/product/ProductCard.tsx

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' emitted on Home. Non-blocking; migrate pointerEvents prop usage to style.pointerEvents in components that still pass it as a prop.
Console warning 'Accessing element.ref was removed in React 19. ref is now a regular prop.' Non-blocking, coming from a dependency; monitor upstream library updates.

action_items: Optional: migrate any remaining pointerEvents prop usage to style.pointerEvents to silence the RN-Web deprecation warning.
Optional: eliminate nested Pressable/button on ProductCard to remove the React DOM hydration warning ('<button> cannot be a descendant of <button>') on web preview.
Nice-to-have: consider auto-focusing the search input on the Search tab for faster catalogue lookup.
critical_code_review_comments: src/api/mock/data.ts holds a well-shaped catalogue; variable product variation detail lookup in mock/provider.ts is correct and matches the app's selection logic (attr.name → term.name).

app/product/[id].tsx correctly gates add-to-basket via `product.isPurchasable && (isVariable ? !!(allSelected && matched?.isInStock) : product.isInStock)` and swaps the CTA label between 'Select options' / 'Add to basket' / 'Unavailable' honestly.
Zustand persistence via src/store/persist.ts + waitForHydration on splash restores basket + favourites reliably before navigating to (tabs).

Env is respected: EXPO_PUBLIC_DATA_SOURCE=mock exposes the mock provider; live Store API client exists behind the switch (as documented, live is blocked in preview by SiteGround bot protection and CORS).
seed_data_creation: None. Preview uses the built-in mock catalogue (src/api/mock/data.ts).
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is Expo/RN + expo-router served on web preview at EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Mock data source (EXPO_PUBLIC_DATA_SOURCE=mock). Key routes verified: /, /(tabs), /shop, /search, /orders, /account, /product/[id] (simple: 101, variable: 104 Protein Powder / 401 Water Bottle), /category/[id] (11 supplements), /favourites, /basket. Variable-product Add-to-basket testIDs use the slug form (e.g. variation-option-Flavour-vanilla, variation-option-Size-500g — lowercase slugs, not term.name). Search screen renders results as ProductRow (data-testid=product-row-*), NOT product-card-* — adjust selectors accordingly. Coupon APEPS10 is a valid demo coupon. Everything else in Milestone 1 is wired and honest.
rca_of_issue: No functional defects were found. Two console warnings observed are non-functional (React-Native-Web pointerEvents deprecation, and React 19 element.ref access warning coming from a dependency). One DOM hydration warning on the shop listing stems from nested Pressables inside ProductCard on the web target; native is unaffected.
